image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a common iguana (Iguana iguana) perched on a textured surface. The image focuses on the head, neck, and upper torso. The iguana displays characteristic features including a prominent dewlap, a serrated dorsal crest running down the neck, and rough, granular scales. The coloration is a mix of greyish-green and darker bands, suggesting an adult or sub-adult specimen. The background is softly blurred (bokeh), indicating a shallow depth of field.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is clearly visible and consistent with iguana morphology. The large, fan-like dewlap is prominently displayed under the jaw.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is sharp and in focus. It shows a round pupil and the iris appears to have yellow/golden tones, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: A large circular subtympanic shield (scale) is present below the tympanum.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The large, circular scale located behind the jaw angle (subtympanic shield) is clearly visible and distinct from the surrounding smaller scales.
The visible portion of the torso appears thick and muscular, consistent with a robust body structure.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The iguana exhibits greyish-green tones with darker banding on the neck and shoulder area, fitting the adult/sub-adult description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal crest spines are sharply defined and run continuously from the neck downwards. They appear structurally sound and correctly spaced.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: High-frequency texture details show distinct granular scales on the body and larger, irregular plates on the snout and head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the shoulder/upper arm is visible, the feet and digits are either out of frame or obscured by the foreground elements/angle. Cannot verify digit count.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail extends out of the frame immediately behind the shoulders. Its full length and compression cannot be verified.
